observations: Before handoff approval, readiness was almost satisfied except for one missing REMOTE fact: whether the canonical Dogfood record schema already supported structured decision-value checkpoints.
DV-013-001 recorded MORE_CONTEXT_REQUIRED because that fact could change execution_strategy and task_class.
Chat acquired exactly that authoritative fact from the shared GitHub baseline; it showed that structured Dogfood measurement was unsupported by the closed measurements schema.
The repository fact changed the candidate execution strategy from bounded documentation work to architectural schema and regression work.
No Approved Handoff existed when the candidate route changed, so the lifecycle did not emit Re-route Required.
The developer approved the architectural route, after which DV-013-002 recorded NO_MORE_CONTEXT_NEEDED with source NONE, a null missing fact, and no material targets.
Implementation then proceeded under Approved Handoff Revision 1 in an isolated workspace without implementation subagents.

Regression-first execution produced 12 RED cases before the schema change: both approved checkpoint shapes were rejected and 10 adversarial cases failed for the pre-feature reason rather than their intended invariant.
The smallest optional additive schema extension used verifier-supported oneOf validation, so scripts/verify.mjs did not change and historical Dogfood records required no migration.
After the schema extension, the complete regression suite turned GREEN: both approved decisions passed and all 10 adversarial cases failed for their intended conditional or structural reason.
A fresh independent reviewer reported no Critical, Important, or Minor findings and confirmed backward compatibility, machine validation, test quality, and authority-boundary integrity.
Fresh final verification passed after the review evidence and Dogfood record were finalized.
